transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, ConversalQ support. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I need to reset my password. I'm locked out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No problem. The quickest way is through our self-service portal — go to conversalq.com and click 'Forgot Password'. You'll get a reset link in under a minute. Do you still have access to the email on your account?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes I do. Let me try that... I got the email. Following the link now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. The link is valid for 15 minutes. Once you set a new password, you'll be logged in automatically.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Done! I'm in now. That was really easy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent! For extra security, I'd recommend enabling two-factor authentication in your account settings. It only takes about 2 minutes to set up.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Good idea. I'll do that. Thanks!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Have a great day.
